issue_context.title: Blocking call for `telegram_bot`  in 2024.9.0b0
issue_context.body:

`2024-08-28 19:31:44.318 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.util.loop] Detected blocking call to load_verify_locations with args (<ssl.SSLContext object at 0x7f4c6fe350>,) inside the event loop by integration 'telegram_bot' at homeassistant/components/telegram_bot/__init__.py, line 526: request = HTTPXRequest(connection_pool_size=8) (offender: /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/httpx/_config.py, line 147: context.load_verify_locations(cafile=cafile))`

review_comments: There are async API, eg issue creation, calls inside `initialize_bot` those will need to be updated to use the sync versions of the API.

Just for clarification: It was ok before adding the `async_add_executor_job`, because it was executed within the main event loop, right?
`initialize_bot` being a sync function doesn't make a difference here.

Only because we now move it into a separate thread, the async API functions needed to be changed.
